The Subtask Name: Identify the screenwriter of The Poor Boob and their birthplace state
Step Range: 0-6
The Oracle: Margaret Mayo, Illinois
Evidence: Steps 0-2 establish the task and initial search for Hillcrest High School and The Poor Boob screenwriter. Steps 3-6 confirm Margaret Mayo as the screenwriter and her birthplace as Brownsville, Illinois.

The Subtask Name: Determine the capital city of the screenwriter's birth state and the year it became capital
Step Range: 7-20
The Oracle: Springfield, 1839
Evidence: Steps 7-10 identify Illinois as the birth state and Springfield as its capital, with searches confirming the year 1839 as the date Springfield became the capital. Steps 11-20 involve repeated verification of these facts and checking the specific Hillcrest High School location in Illinois (Country Club Hills) to ensure the question's logic holds (i.e., the city where the school is located is not the capital, but the question asks when the capital of the birth state became capital, which is Springfield in 1839).
